composite =: 3 : 0
    image =. (PixelCount,3)$3{.Background
    for_box. Layers do.
        layer =. >box
        ids =. I.'painted' get_key layer
        alpha =. ids{effective_alpha layer

        mode =. 'mode' get_key layer

region_code =: 4 : 0
    'px py' =. x

clip_segment =: 3 : 0
    'start finish clip' =. y
    'x0 y0 x1 y1' =. clip
    while. 1 do.
        first =. start region_code clip
        last =. finish region_code clip
        if. (-.+./first)*.-.+./last do. start,:finish return. end.
        if. +./first*.last do. empty_points '' return. end.
        if. +./first do. code =. first
            outside =. start
            other =. finish
        else. code =. last
            outside =. finish
            other =. start end.
        'ax ay' =. outside
        'bx by' =. other
        if. 2{code do. point =. (ax+((bx-ax)*(y0-ay)) round_ratio by-ay),y0
        elseif. 3{code do. point =. (ax+((bx-ax)*(y1-ay)) round_ratio by-ay),y1
        elseif. 1{code do. point =. x1,ay+((by-ay)*(x1-ax)) round_ratio bx-ax
        else. point =. x0,ay+((by-ay)*(x0-ax)) round_ratio bx-ax end.
        if. +./first do. start =. point else. finish =. point end.
    end.
)
inside_boundary =: 4 : 0

boundary_intersection =: 3 : 0

    if. axis=0 do. limit,sy+((limit-sx)*(ey-sy)) round_ratio ex-sx
    else. (sx+((limit-sy)*(ex-sx)) round_ratio ey-sy),limit end.
)
clip_polygon =: 4 : 0
    vertices =. x
    'x0 y0 x1 y1' =. y
    boundaries =. 4 3$0,x0,1,0,(x1+1),0,1,y0,1,1,(y1+1),0
    for_boundary. boundaries do.
        output =. empty_points ''
        if. 0=#vertices do. output return. end.
        'axis limit minimum' =. boundary
        for_index. i.#vertices do.
            start =. ((#vertices)|index-1){vertices
            finish =. index{vertices
            if. boundary inside_boundary finish do.
                if. -.boundary inside_boundary start do. output =. output,boundary_intersection (<start),(<finish),(<axis),<limit end.
                output =. output,finish
            elseif. boundary inside_boundary start do. output =. output,boundary_intersection (<start),(<finish),(<axis),<limit end.
        end.
        vertices =. output
    end.
    vertices
)

fill_polygons =: 3 : 0
    'sequences rule clip' =. y
    edges =. 0$a:
    for_box. sequences do.
        vertices =. >box
        for_index. i.#vertices do.
            start =. index{vertices
            finish =. ((#vertices)|index+1){vertices
            if. (1{start)~:1{finish do. edges =. edges,<start,:finish end.
        end.
    end.
    'x0 y0 x1 y1' =. clip
    pixels =. 0$0
    for_py. y0+i.1+y1-y0 do.
        crossings =. 0 2$0
        for_box. edges do.
            edge =. >box
            'xa ya xb yb' =. ,edge
            if. (py<ya<.yb)+.py>:ya>.yb do. continue. end.
            denominator =. yb-ya
            numerator =. (2*xa*denominator)+(((2*py)+1)-2*ya)*(xb-xa)
            direction =. 1
            if. denominator<0 do. numerator =. -numerator
                denominator =. -denominator
                direction =. _1 end.
            first =. 1+(numerator-denominator) div 2*denominator
            crossings =. crossings,first,direction
        end.
        crossings =. (/:crossings){crossings
        count =. winding =. index =. 0
        for_px. x0+i.1+x1-x0 do.
            while. index<#crossings do.
                if. px<(<index,0){crossings do. break. end.
                count =. count+1
                winding =. winding+(<index,1){crossings
                index =. index+1
            end.
            if. rule-:'evenodd' do. filled =. 1=2|count else. filled =. winding~:0 end.
            if. filled do. pixels =. pixels,(py*Width)+px end.
        end.
    end.
    pixels
)
fill_shape =: 3 : 0
    'center points clip' =. y
    'cx cy' =. center
    'x0 y0 x1 y1' =. clip
    pixels =. 0$0
    for_dy. ~.1{"1 points do.
        py =. cy+dy
        if. (py<y0)+.py>y1 do. continue. end.
        extent =. >./|0{"1 points#~dy=1{"1 points
        first =. x0>.cx-extent
        last =. x1<.cx+extent
        if. first<:last do. pixels =. pixels,(py*Width)+first+i.1+last-first end.
    end.
    pixels
)
flood_fill =: 3 : 0
    'seed clip' =. y
    colors =. layer_get 'colors'
    painted =. layer_get 'painted'
    id =. (Width*1{seed)+0{seed
    target =. id{colors
    targetpainted =. id{painted
    seen =. 1 id}PixelCount$0
    queue =. ,id
    head =. 0
    while. head<#queue do.
        id =. head{queue
        head =. head+1
        point =. (Width|id),id div Width
        for_delta. 4 2$1 0 _1 0 0 1 0 _1 do.
            other =. point+delta
            if. -.clip contains other do. continue. end.
            nextid =. (Width*1{other)+0{other
            if. nextid{seen do. continue. end.
            if. targetpainted~:nextid{painted do. continue. end.
            if. targetpainted do. if. -.target-:nextid{colors do. continue. end. end.
            seen =. 1 nextid}seen
            queue =. queue,nextid
        end.
    end.
    I.seen
)

parse_path =: 3 : 0
    commands =. 0$a:
    position =. 0
    previous =. 'Z'
    while. position<#y do.
        letter =. position{::y

        count =. (PathLetters i.letter){PathArity
        if. (position+count)>:#y do. a: return. end.
        values =. count{.(position+1)}.y
        if. -.all_integers values do. a: return. end.
        if. (previous e.'Zz')*.-.letter e.'Mm' do. a: return. end.
        commands =. commands,<'letter values' record (<letter),<signed_num&>values
        previous =. letter

            pen =. 'width color on off' record (<signed_num 0{::values),(1{values),(<signed_num 2{::values),<signed_num 3{::values

        if. key-:'CANVAS' do.

        else.

            else. Symbols =: ((<name),<block) put_key Symbols end.

check_command =: 3 : 0

    end.

    'ex ey' =. y
    dx =. |ex-px

    end.

ellipse_points =: 3 : 0

        points =. points,4 2$px,py,(-px),py,px,(-py),(-px),-py
    end.
    while. py>0 do.

        py =. py-1
